summary: Backend: All 16 tests PASS (login/me/forgot/reset regression, full change-email negative path coverage including 401-no-auth, 401-wrong-password, 400-same-email, 400-invalid-email, 400-email-taken, 200 happy path; confirm: 401-no-auth, 400-invalid code; personal-profile GET/PUT and feedback POST regression). BUILD 196 visible. react_native_issues.issue: React Native web deprecation warning across the app: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' — flagged for migration. Reference: frontend codebase (multiple stylesheets).
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Remove the top-right banner EDIT (pencil) button from /personal-info read-only header — only the lower 'EDIT INFORMATION' button should remain (requirement #32 option A).

Manually verify the 'Price required' alert flow on /tool/edit — automated check could not capture the alert via window.alert hook nor as in-DOM text after tapping CREATE TOOL with only a Name filled. End-to-end happy-path verification of #33 change-email/confirm requires reading the 6-digit code from the destination inbox — please run a manual round trip with a real inbox you can access.
Migrate deprecated React Native web style props: 'textShadow*' -> 'textShadow', and move 'pointerEvents' prop into style.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5120 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting auth_router, dealer_router, tool_router into separate modules.

Change-email endpoints correctly mirror the forgot/reset pattern: bcrypt-hashed code, 15-min TTL, 5-attempt cap, IP-based rate limit, generic error on taken-email to avoid user enumeration. Implementation looks solid.
